items.name: Hand-painted wallpaper installation
items.title: Hand-Painted Wallpaper Installer London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Installation of hand-painted, scenic and chinoiserie wallpapers in London, in the manner of de Gournay and Fromental. Survey, set-out, hang and aftercare.
items.heading: Hand-painted wallpaper installation
items.lede: Scenic, chinoiserie and panelled hand-painted papers, in the manner of de Gournay and Fromental, hung in London houses and hotels.
paragraphs: Hand-painted papers need a sound wall, a patient set-out and time. Panels are usually supplied in a sequence, and the scene has to meet across doors, windows and corners. We plan the set-out from a fixed point before the first panel goes up.
Preparation follows the maker's specification. Some papers are hung over a lining, some are not. If the wall is not ready for the material, we say so at the survey.
This is installation. We hang these papers; we do not make them, and we are not affiliated with any maker. Brown's Hotel, Mayfair includes scenic and chinoiserie wallcoverings photographed on site.

faq.question: Do hand-painted wallpapers need lining paper?
paragraphs: It depends on the maker's specification. Some are hung over a lining, some are specified without one. We follow the specification.

faq.question: How are scenic wallpaper panels set out?
paragraphs: From a fixed point, in the supplied sequence, so the scene meets where it should around doors, windows and corners. The set-out is agreed before the first panel is hung.

items.name: Grasscloth installation
items.title: Grasscloth Wallpaper Installer London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Grasscloth and natural weave wallcovering installation in London. Seams, colour variation and weave direction agreed before the first length is cut.
items.heading: Grasscloth and natural weave installation
items.lede: Grasscloth, sisal, raffia and other natural weaves, hung in London houses and hotels.
paragraphs: The irregularity is the point of the material. Colour and weave vary from roll to roll, and the seams are visible. We agree that, and the direction of the weave, before the first length is cut.
Natural weaves mark easily and do not forgive adhesive on the face. They are hung with clean hands and an adhesive that suits the backing, following the maker's instruction.
Quantities allow for the variation between rolls, so lengths from the same batch can be kept together on a wall.

faq.question: Will grasscloth seams be visible?
paragraphs: Yes. Visible seams and colour variation between rolls are part of the material. We agree how that will look, and the direction of the weave, before hanging.

faq.question: How do you clean grasscloth?
paragraphs: Gently, and dry. The care notes for each material are on the aftercare page.

items.name: Silk wallcovering installation
items.title: Silk Wallcovering Installer London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Silk wallcovering installation in London houses and hotels. Clean hands, the right adhesive and seams planned so the light does not catch a ridge.
items.heading: Silk wallcovering installation
items.lede: Silk wallcoverings, plain and patterned, hung in London houses and hotels.
paragraphs: Silk is lustrous, and quick to mark. It is hung with clean hands and an adhesive that suits the cloth. Seams are planned so the light from the windows does not catch a ridge.
The wall has to be right first. Preparation, including a lining where the maker specifies one, is written into the scope.
Protection of floors, furniture and finished joinery is part of the hang, not an optional extra.

faq.question: Is silk wallpaper hard to install?
paragraphs: It is unforgiving. Adhesive on the face or a ridge at the seam shows in raking light. That is why the set-out, the adhesive and the preparation are planned before the first length.

items.name: Fabric walling
items.title: Fabric Walling & Textile Wallcovering London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Fabric walling and textile wallcovering installation in London. Wider goods, careful edges at joinery, skirtings and reveals.
items.heading: Fabric walling and textile wallcoverings
items.lede: Textile on the wall, often in wider goods, for drawing rooms, bedrooms, dressing rooms and hotel suites.
paragraphs: Fabric walling needs care at the edges and wherever it meets joinery, skirtings and reveals. The set-out is planned so joins fall where they are least seen.
Paper-backed textiles are hung like a wallcovering. Other fabrics have their own method, and we follow the maker's instruction and the designer's specification.
As with every material, aftercare is included: a return visit once the room has settled, and a twelve-month guarantee on the workmanship.

faq.question: Can you hang wide-width fabric wallcoverings?
paragraphs: Yes. Wider goods need more hands and careful handling, especially at corners and openings. We plan for that in the scope.

items.name: Hotel wallcovering installation
items.title: Hotel Wallcovering Contractor London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Hotel wallcovering contractor in London: contract vinyl, Vescom and specialist papers for bedrooms and corridors. The OWO, Brown's Hotel, Four Seasons.
items.heading: Hotel wallcovering installation
items.lede: Bedrooms, corridors and public areas in London hotels, hung to programme and around the house. Public commissions include The OWO, Brown's Hotel, Four Seasons Ten Trinity Square and hotels in Holborn and at Silverstone.
paragraphs: Contract vinyls are the usual specification in busy hotel rooms and corridors. At The OWO, Whitehall, the install was Vescom wallcoverings, to walls and to parts of the joinery, between 2020 and 2022.

Hotel work moves floor by floor or room by room around guests. Delivery of free-issue goods is timed to the hang, and paper is not left in corridors. A project leader is on site every day, and on a longer commission senior oversight agrees a forward plan each week.

Where Mr Wallcover is appointed as main decorating contractor, the package can include fine painting, French polishing and other specialist finishes, as it did at Brown's Hotel, Mayfair, from 2022 to 2024.

faq.question: Can you install wallcoverings in a hotel that stays open?
paragraphs: Yes. Most of our hotel work has been in live buildings. The work is contained, moves around the house's bookings, and the area is left tidy.

faq.question: Do you take the whole decorating package?
paragraphs: We can. At Brown's Hotel and the hotel at 15 Old Bailey, Mr Wallcover was the main decorating contractor. Elsewhere we have carried the wallcovering package alone.

items.name: Mural installation
items.title: Wallpaper Mural Installer London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Printed and hand-made wallpaper mural installation in London. Set out from a fixed point so the scene meets around doors and corners.
items.heading: Mural installation
items.lede: Printed and hand-made murals for houses, hotels and shops in London.
paragraphs: Murals are set out from a fixed point so the scene meets where it should, including around doors and corners. Panels are checked against the supplier's layout before hanging.
Some murals are specified with a lining paper and some without. We follow the specification, and we say at the survey if the wall needs work first.
Measurements for a bespoke print are taken on site so the artwork is sized to the wall that will actually be hung.

faq.question: Will you measure the wall for a bespoke mural?
paragraphs: Yes. We measure on site, take out the openings and give the supplier the dimensions of the wall that will actually be hung.

items.name: Acoustic wallcovering installation
items.title: Acoustic Wallcovering & Panel Installer London | Mr Wallcover
items.description: Acoustic wallcovering and acoustic panel installation in London hotels, offices and homes. Hung to the maker's instruction so the face keeps its performance.
items.heading: Acoustic wallcovering installation
items.lede: Acoustic wallcoverings and panels for hotels, offices, restaurants and homes.
paragraphs: Acoustic wallcoverings and panels are hung so the face keeps the performance it was specified for. Adhesive, trimming and edges follow the maker's instruction.
They often sit alongside other finishes in the same room, so set-out and junctions with joinery and other wallcoverings are planned at the survey.
Aftercare and the twelve-month workmanship guarantee apply as with any other material.

faq.question: Where are acoustic wallcoverings used?
paragraphs: Commonly in hotel corridors and function rooms, restaurants, offices, and in homes where a room needs to be quieter. We install to the maker's specification.
